splits.online: final eligible monthly cutoff; earlier cutoffs development
splits.retailrocket: 80th percentile of episode timestamps, lower interpolation

kill_rule: PROCEED iff online logistic PR-AUC exceeds prevalence PR-AUC by >=0.02 with bootstrap delta CI lower bound >0 OR Retailrocket transition accuracy exceeds global accuracy by >=0.02; permutation must not match the qualifying gain; both datasets must be technically evaluable. Otherwise STOP.
